title: Delinquency, Charge-Off and Inactivity Thresholds for Ridgeline Consumer Credit
content:
Ridgeline Consumer Credit account standing turns on the following tier thresholds.

| | Card Classic | Card Preferred | Card Premier | Project Loan 66 | Project Loan 78 | Project Loan 84 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days past due at which charging or drawing privileges are suspended | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Days past due at which the account is charged off | 180 | 180 | 180 | 120 | 120 | 120 |
| Consecutive on-time minimum payments required for reinstatement | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Months with no purchase and no payment after which the bank may close the account | 24 | 24 | 36 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Account may be closed with a balance still owed | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

**Notes**

- The reinstatement figure counts the consecutive on-time minimum payments required, after the past-due amount is cleared, before a suspended account is reinstated.
- An inactivity figure of 0 means the bank never closes the account for inactivity; it applies to every Ridgeline Project Loan tier.
- Every tier allows the cardholder to close the account while a balance is still owed.

Hypothetical contrast: an account 150 days past due is beyond the charge-off threshold of a Project Loan tier (120) but not of a card tier (180).
